# Claude Code Undocumented Transcript

A transcript is the file where Claude Code saves a session.
Some of its entry types and fields are not in the official docs.
All 17 rows are found only in the program.
Anthropic can change or remove each item in any release.

## Found Only in the Program

17 items are in the program but not in the official docs.
These are the most useful ones.

- `--reply-on-resume`: A hidden flag that asks the model to reply at once when the transcript ends with a user message. See [Sessions and Storage](Claude-Code-Sessions-And-Storage).
- `assistant`: A reply of the model, where `message` holds `usage` with the token counts. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `system`: A note, with the subtypes `turn_duration`, `local_command`, `informational`, and `compact_boundary`. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `api-request-blob`: A message that is stored by its hash. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `ai-title`: The title that the model made. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `last-prompt`: The last prompt, for the picker. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `attachment`: Context that Claude Code adds. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `api-request-shape`: The `system` and `tools` of a request, stored once. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `queue-operation`: A prompt or command that waits in the queue. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
- `user`: A user turn or a tool result, where `parentUuid` links the chain. See [Sessions Transcript](Claude-Code-Sessions-Transcript).
